Comment: Remove defunct topics/format.js require from menutopic/format.php (Moodle 4.x compat)

commands: echo '=== Patch 4: Remove topics/format.js require from menutopic/format.php ==='
if [ ! -f "$FORMAT_PHP" ]; then echo 'ERROR: format.php not found'; exit 1; fi
echo '✓ Removed defunct topics/format.js require line'
echo '✓ Already clean — topics/format.js require not present'
grep -n 'topics/format.js' "$FORMAT_PHP" && echo 'STILL PRESENT - check manually' || echo 'Confirmed: line absent'
echo '=== Restart PHP-FPM to flush OPcache ==='
systemctl restart php-fpm && echo 'php-fpm restarted' || echo 'restart failed'
